payload.description_html: Giganotosaurus is one of the largest carnivores ever to walk the earth. A carcharodontosaurid theropod, it could reach an estimated 13 m in total body length. Carcharodontosaurids like Giganotosaurus are known for having teeth suited for slashing, rather than bone-crushing, which they likely used for ripping flesh off the giant sauropods that they hunted.
